closure_definition: authenticated user sees a homepage identity signal and can close the access loop through logout
trigger: valid authenticated state exists after configured credential login
core_behavior: show current user signal on homepage, expose logout, and invalidate access after logout
observable_result: signed-in user can identify the active account; after logout, homepage access returns to login

acceptance_criteria.description: authenticated homepage shows current user identity signal and logout entry
acceptance_criteria.example_input: configured user has just signed in
acceptance_criteria.expected_result: homepage displays the current user identity signal and a logout entry
acceptance_criteria.boundary_case: refreshing homepage while authenticated keeps identity signal visible
acceptance_criteria.failure_mode: homepage hides who is signed in or lacks a logout path

acceptance_criteria.description: logout invalidates homepage access for the old browser state
acceptance_criteria.example_input: authenticated user activates logout and then requests homepage again
acceptance_criteria.expected_result: browser returns to login and authenticated homepage content is not visible
acceptance_criteria.boundary_case: repeated logout or repeated post-logout homepage request stays signed out
acceptance_criteria.failure_mode: old session still opens homepage after logout

priority_basis: homepage and logout complete the same user-visible access loop after UNIT-1 establishes authentication

protected_behaviors: homepage content is visible only after successful login
logout removes ability to view homepage through old state
business_constraints: design can choose presentation; PM-owned access and invalidation behavior stays fixed

verification_plan.expected_observation: homepage shows current user identity signal and logout entry
login entry is shown and authenticated homepage content is absent

design_decision_candidates.constraints: must make current signed-in user observable; must keep logout discoverable
design_decision_candidates.design_handoff: choose presentation that preserves homepage identity and logout behavior
